{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out QC-failed baseline values (-999)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print(f'Number of rows after removing -999: {len(df_clean)}')

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print(f'Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}')

# Step 3: Compute the mean baseline biomarker value (already in ng/mL)
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_baseline}')"}
